Landing.heroTitle: Create and play cooperative isometric escape rooms in the browser
Landing.heroSubtitle: Publish and monetize rooms without writing code — the editor IS the game engine — or build a whole room by chatting with an AI agent.

creator.title: For creators
creator.body: Publish and monetize rooms without knowing how to code; the editor is the actual game engine (real WYSIWYG) and the MCP lets you build a whole room by describing it to the chat.

player.title: For players
player.body: Cooperative 1-4 player escape rooms in the browser, with voice and webcam, nothing to install.

teacher.title: For teachers
teacher.body: Run games for your class, hand out access keys and follow each group's progress without leaving the browser.

company.title: For companies
company.body: Buy per player with tiered discounts and run team-building sessions remotely or in person, nothing to install.

loginRequired.emailLabel: Or with a magic link by email
loginRequired.emailSent: We've sent a link to your email.
loginRequired.error: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.

step1.title: 1. Choose a theme
step1.body: This first version's theme pack is medieval: castle, dungeon and period props. It's the starting point for every room.

step2.title: 2. Paint your first room
step2.body: Start from a pre-filled template instead of a blank canvas: an editable copy of "The Curse of King Aldric", the platform's reference room. Take it apart, delete what you don't need and make it yours, or start blank.
step2.templateDesc: 3 rooms, 8 puzzles already solved as an example — see how it's built and edit it.
step2.blankDesc: Empty room with the minimum metadata.
step2.cta: Create room and open the editor
step2.error: Couldn't create the room. Please try again.

step3.title: 3. Place 1 guided puzzle
step3.body: In the editor, try the "Decorate" or "Place" tool to add an object and attach a puzzle to it (a lock, for example). Every tool shows a tooltip the first time you use it.
step3.hint: Tip: the King Aldric copy already ships with 8 solved puzzles — open one in the inspector to see how it's built.

step4.title: 4. Playtest
step4.body: Play your own room in a temporary session before publishing it, without it counting as a real playthrough.

step5.title: 5. Publish
step5.body: When you're ready, publish your room from the editor — the validator explains every warning before it blocks publishing. Not ready yet? Save the draft and come back anytime.
